messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Soldier, stay calm. Since your contact with the alien egg, your emotional reactions have directly influenced its development.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: We are starting a full test protocol. Each answer will help us understand what kind of bond formed between you and the creature.

choices.label: Understood, Professor. I am ready to begin.
Before we start, I want to know if this thing is dangerous.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: First test. The egg reacts strongly when you are under pressure. Imagine an alarm triggers and the incubation room locks down.

choices.label: I force access and regain control of the zone.
I analyze the egg’s signals before acting.
I slow my breathing and try to calm it.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Second test. The egg projects images into your mind: an unknown corridor, a sealed door, and a presence waiting behind it.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Your choice seems to alter its internal activity. It is not just responding: it is learning from you.

choices.label: I push forward. A soldier does not retreat from a door.
I explore the unknown corridor to understand what it wants to show me.
I look for logic in the vision to anticipate the danger.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Final test before hatching. The creature can feel your decisions before it fully exists. If it were born now, what impulse would you transmit to it?

choices.label: Protect others, even if it puts me in danger.
Understand its origin and exploit the data.
Survive, secure the zone, and neutralize any threat.
